inheritance: Apply all agent rules; this skill cannot suspend them.
objective: Present results and save only under current authorization.
activation_triggers: Only pending issues or discards are available.
preconditions: The state and validation of every candidate are known.
steps: Present ready notes with their titles, bodies, sources, and edits.
Present pending issues with specific questions and relevant discards with rationale.
Distinguish ready for review from approved by the user.
When saving is authorized and the destination is known, save only validated notes within the authorized scope.
Without authorization, present proposals without creating final notes.
Do not overwrite the source or existing files; handle collisions under the agent's policy.
Check saved files and report their paths and a processing summary.
allowed_actions: Save validated notes under current authorization.
forbidden_actions: Save a pending note as final.
Declare extraction complete while candidates are awaiting answers.
ask_when: A required destination has not been defined.
Requested saving requires resolving a collision without applicable authorization.
outputs: Pending issues and paths when applicable
completion_criteria: Results have been presented, authorized saves checked, and pending issues disclosed.
